prompt:
Animate this lineup of five fantasy heroes, all five at the same time, each performing ONE basic attack in place that fits its weapon, then holding the final pose. The camera is fixed and does not move, zoom or pan. Left and right in this description are the screen's left and right. Forward is screen right: every hero faces screen right and its target is an enemy standing just outside its own cell to the right, at the height of its chest, one weapon length in front of it. Every hero stays exactly where it stands in the image, inside its own cell, the feet planted on the same ground line and never sliding (the floating woman stays hovering at the same height), never touching or overlapping another hero, never leaving the picture, and keeps its own size, design, colours and outline exactly as in the image and keeps only its own weapon. Every hero keeps the near-side view facing screen right, the head looking forward at its target for the whole move; every move starts from the hips, the body leaning into the blow.
1. The armoured knight with the red crest (far left) grips the haft of his huge stone hammer with both hands, coils his hips and shoulders back toward screen left while he raises the hammer up and back over his head, then turns his hips toward the target and chops the hammer straight down in a big arc in front of his body toward screen right, through the target at chest height, ending with the hammer head low in front of him near the ground, and holds that pose.
2. The hooded archer (second from left) lifts his dark bow in his forward hand to point at the target, takes an arrow and nocks it, draws the string back to his cheek with the arrow level and pointing at screen right at chest height, holds the aim for a moment, then releases: the bow arm recoils slightly and he holds the follow-through pose. After the release the arrow simply vanishes; no arrow flies across the picture.
3. The pale floating woman with the cape (middle) stays hovering at the same height, draws her stretched hand back to her chest, then thrusts that open palm hard forward toward screen right at chest height, her hair and cape flaring back, and holds the pose with her arm extended. No light, no glow and no projectile is drawn.
4. The red-haired woman with the double axe (second from right) grips the axe haft with both hands, coils her hips back toward screen left while she raises the axe high above her near shoulder, then turns her hips toward the target and chops the axe down diagonally in front of her body toward screen right, through the target at chest height, ending with the axe head low in front of her, and holds that pose.
5. The stone giant with the black beard (far right) draws his near stone fist back beside his hip, coiling his huge shoulders back toward screen left, then throws one big straight punch forward toward screen right at chest height, his whole upper body turning into the blow, and holds the pose with the arm fully extended; the small flame on his other hand stays small.
No slash arc, no crescent, no swoosh, no motion trail, no afterimage and no effect is drawn behind any weapon or limb. The flat solid pure magenta background stays unchanged and fixed in every frame: no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no effects, no text, no grid, no camera shake.
